learning_outcomes.text: Performs calculations related to energy economics in buildings and industry.
Performs energy recovery calculations in buildings.
Performs energy recovery calculations in industry.
Calculates money saved due to energy economics and the payback period of the investment.

syllabus_topics: Types of energy economics and amortization calculation
Heat losses in pipes, insulation and its importance, energy recovery in industry.
Calculation of heat and energy losses in industry
Examples from industry related to passive energy economics
Increasing the efficiency of energy facilities
Examples from industry related to active energy economics
Sample applications related to energy economics in energy facilities
Sample applications related to energy economics
assessment_rules: The overall grade is determined by 50% from in-term work and 50% from the final exam. In-term work includes a midterm exam (70%), a quiz (15%), and an assignment (15%).
